name: Decorators cannot alter forbidden static-spine identity facts

input.fixture_ref: Apply Class and Contract decorators that attempt each forbidden declaration-kind, identity, package, superclass, Contract, generic and native-layout transformation.

applicability.reason: Requires the C087 decorator PHASES. Decorator resolution is now partly in place: C122 makes a decorator a Class declaring `for` a Decorator Contract, and a Class declared in the program conforming to none is rejected with IRIS-DECORATOR-KIND, alongside the category mismatch already enforced. An undeclared name is still left alone because C070 admits a cross-Module `@D::Stamp()`. What this row waits on is the two-phase machinery of C087/C122/C125: `plan`/`transform` members, the `Plan` and `Transformation` types, and applying a returned transformation inside the candidate transaction. Until a decorator can RETURN a transformation, no source decorator can request the forbidden static-spine changes this row exercises, even though `decorator::apply_pending` already enforces C091 on them.

expect.status: Every forbidden transform aborts the candidate and no changed nominal identity or static-spine fact is published.
